name: 基础模板-轰炸机-空军模板
name_ja: 基本テンプレート-爆撃機-航空機テンプレート
name_zh_TW: 基礎模板-轟炸機-空軍模板
data:
#注释是一些提示，请结合助手的代码表使用该轰炸机模板
[core]
name: bomberTemplate
class: CustomUnitMetadata
price: 4000
maxHp: 3000
mass: 20000

techLevel: 2
buildSpeed: 0.00025
availableInDemo: true

radius: 16
displayRadius: 19
isBio: false
#softCollisionOnAll: 3
softCollisionOnAll:24


selfRegenRate:0.1

#单位标题
displayText:示范轰炸机

#单位描述
displayDescription:轰炸机空军模板，请参考ini里面的注释和结合代码表使用。


builtFrom_1_name: airFactory
builtFrom_1_pos:  6.1

#能量最大值
energyMax: 3
#能量恢复
energyRegen: 0.002
#能量必须充满后才能使用
energyNeedsToRechargeToFull: true



[graphics]
total_frames: 1

image:        CORE:/bomber/base.png
image_wreak:  CORE:/bomber/base_dead.png
image_turret: NONE
#scaleImagesTo: 20
#scaleTurretImagesTo: 9

image_shadow: AUTO
shadowOffsetX:1
shadowOffsetY:1

[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: true

turretSize: 20
turretTurnSpeed: 1.5

maxAttackRange: 45
shootDelay: 30

#攻击移动方式：轰炸机
attackMovement: bomber



[turret_1]
#bomber
invisible: true
x: 0
y: 0
idleDir:0
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false


projectile: 1
size: 1.1
turnSpeed: 20

#消耗能量
energyUsage: 1


[projectile_1]
#bomb

#cannot use directDamage with targetGround
#directDamage: 195

life: 250
speed: 0.3
targetSpeed: 1.7
drawSize: 1
color: #000000
trailEffect: false


#大冲击效果
largeHitEffect: true

#目标为地面
targetGround: true

#范围伤害
areaDamage: 370
areaRadius: 65

#for laser defence
deflectionPower: 3
#激光拦截该炮弹需要的能量

[turret_2]
#anti-sub
invisible: true
x: 0
y: 0
idleDir:0
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   false
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: true

projectile: 2
size: 1.1
turnSpeed: 20

energyUsage: 1

[projectile_2]
#bomb anti-sub

directDamage: 70

life: 250
speed: 0.3
targetSpeed: 1.7
drawSize: 1
color: #000000
trailEffect: false
largeHitEffect: false

targetGround: false

#for laser defence
deflectionPower: 3

[movement]
movementType: AIR
moveSpeed: 0.85
moveAccelerationSpeed: 0.01
moveDecelerationSpeed: 0.01

#着陆条件：闲置
landOnGround: onlyIdle

#joinsGroupFormations=false可能会导致非飞行单位的速度减慢。
joinsGroupFormations: false

maxTurnSpeed: 1.2
turnAcceleration: 0.04

moveSlidingMode :false
moveIgnoringBody:false
moveSlidingDir:  25

#死亡坠落
slowDeathFall: true
